questions.question: Define an interface 'User' with a string 'name' and number 'age', then create a typed variable 'user'.
questions.correctAnswer:
interface User { name: string; age: number; }
const user: User = { name: 'John', age: 30 };
questions.solution: interface User { name: string; age: number; }
questions.explanation: TypeScript interfaces provide strong typing for objects.
